name: Switzerland
exam_name: Grundkenntnistest (canton of Zürich); the name and form differ by canton and commune
administering_agency: The canton and the commune of residence

regional_variants.name: Zürich
regional_variants.note: Applicants must show basic knowledge of the geography, politics, history and society of Switzerland, of the canton and of its communes; the Grundkenntnistest is one way to prove it.

unverified.format: There is no national format: each canton sets its own. Zürich’s test page was not read beyond its existence.
unverified.languages: German for Zürich, the only canton read; other cantons use their own official language.
unverified.fee: Zürich lists cantonal and communal naturalization fees; none for the test alone was read.

notes: Federal law leaves the check to the cantons: the federal office says the canton verifies that the applicant is integrated and "familiar with the Swiss way of life" and may add requirements. Only Zürich was read here. The other 25 cantons each need their own entry before this profile is complete.
